page.overview:
Who is Coral?

Coral is an admin of the Explorers and a major antagonist appearing in .

Coral is a short girl with rose-pink hair with medium-length bangs, which have two long strands hanging on the sides. Her hair is tied in two pigtails, fastened with white hairbands, and she wears a bandage on her hair.

Her eyes are dark brown, and she normally wears a black, baggy, shoulderless top with small pink spikes on the sides. Under her sleeves, she wears long pink nails, similar to the pink of her hair.

She wears a short, black skirt with a yellow pattern down the side, fastened by a yellow belt. Coral also wears a pair of high-top socks with a yellow patch on the tops. On her left leg, a patch is left empty, while on her right, she has a bandage just below her knee. Her shoes are black high-tops with a white band on the top.
